title: Identification of Molecular Subtypes in Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma with Predictive and Prognostic Importance
protocol: Install and include the relevant Bioconductor library for Affymetrix microarrays.
Use the "affy" package in R for preprocessing CEL files from different platforms of Affymetrix microarrays.
Load the required CEL files into R using the ReadAffy function.
Apply robust multiarray (RMA) statistics to preprocess the data using rma function.
Extract expression values using exprs function and store them as log2 scale.
Map probesets to gene symbols using relevant library for the type of Affymetrix array used.
Write a table of RMA processed gene expression profile data with gene symbols, samples in columns and genes in rows.
Prepare two files for ComBat: a gene expression index file and a sample information file.
Install "ComBat" as described on its website.
Execute "ComBat.R".
Run ComBat using the command _ComBat("your expression file name", "your sample information")_.
The results with batch adjusted data will be written in the same directory.
Load required CEL files into the R environment using _ReadAffy_ function.
Fit a specified robust linear model to probe level data using _fitPLM_ function.
Calculate normalized unscaled standard error (NUSE) for each gene on each array using _NUSE(Pset)_ function with main parameter set to "NUSE".
Exclude arrays from further analysis if their median SE or NUSE score falls outside the range of 1 + 0.25 and 1 - 0.25.
Obtain NUSE statistics for all arrays using _NUSE(Pset, type = "stats")_ function.
Download Java based DWD and install it as described on the DWD description page.
Screen each dataset for probesets/genes with standard deviation greater than 0.8.
Select unique genes by choosing only the gene-specific probe with the highest SD among all probes for that given gene.
Remove probes that do not map to any gene.
Normalize samples in each dataset \(N(0,1)) and row normalize (by median centering).
Use R code for normalization and merging datasets using DWD.
Perform row median centering of the merged dataset before proceeding to the next step.
Source the NMF R code from the specified directory for analysis.
Load the siggenes library.
Read DWD merged file into dataMerged variable using read.delim function.
Generate numeric matrix from dataMerged file and assign it to dataMerged_m variable.
Set column names of dataMerged_m as columns 2 onwards from dataMerged.
Set row names of dataMerged_m as the first column of dataMerged.
Read classes for each sample from NMF output file into con variable using read.delim function.
Match the first column of con with column names in dataMerged to obtain m.
Use the log-rank test for univariate associations with survival.
Perform survival Kaplan-Meier curve and log-rank test using web-based GenePattern software SurvivalCurve and SurvivalDifference, respectively.
Provide a tab-delimited file with sample id, class, censor (0 - censored and 1 - not censored), and overall survival (in days) as an input for the program.
Use the Cox proportional hazards model for multivariate modeling of survival using the R package _survival_.
Load the required library: _library(survival)_.
Read the data file: _sur <- read.delim("survival.txt", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)_.

Analyze with coxph function: _coxph(formula = Surv(as.numeric(sur[,4]), as.numeric(sur[,3])) ~ as.factor(sur[,2]), data = sur)_ where _sur[,4]_ should be time, _sur[,3]_ should be censored data (0 or 1), and _sur[,2]_ should be class or subtype.
Apply Fisher’s exact test to investigate the relationships among subtype, stage, and grade.
